user.title: TransIP account
user.description:
Enter your TransIP login and the private key of a Key Pair (created in the TransIP control panel under My account > API). The Key Pair must NOT be restricted to a whitelisted IP, since the whole point of this integration is that your IP changes.

Paste the COMPLETE private key, including the first line `-----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY-----` (or `-----BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY-----`) and the last line `-----END PRIVATE KEY-----`. Pasting only the middle section will fail.

record.title: DNS record
record.description: Add a DNS record to keep in sync with your external IP. The record must already exist in the zone (create it once in the TransIP control panel); this integration only updates its content.

abort.already_configured: This TransIP account is already configured.

notifications.title: Notification settings
notifications.description: Choose how you want to be notified when a DNS record is updated.

data.notify_persistent: Show a persistent notification in Home Assistant
data.notify_event: Fire a 'transip_dns_updated' event (for your own automations, e.g. a mobile push notification)
data.notify_targets: Send directly to these notify targets (e.g. mobile_app_your_phone) - select one or more, or type a name that isn't listed yet

panel.title: Panel
panel.description: With the panel on, the gear button on the integration page opens a full page instead of this dialog, and every setting moves there. Switch it off from the panel, or with the transip_dns.set_panel_enabled service.

data.panel_enabled: Use the panel instead of this dialog
data.panel_sidebar: Also show the panel in the sidebar
